dashboard.title: Administration panel
dashboard.description: An overview of the portal, and access to account and offer moderation and to the catalog.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Search students and companies; activate or deactivate their accounts.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Review every offer and remove the ones that break the rules.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Categories and tags that organize the offers.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Students and companies registered in the portal. A deactivated account cannot log in, and a deactivated company's offers are hidden.
users.deactivateText: They will not be able to log in until the account is reactivated. A company's offers are hidden meanwhile. They are notified by email with the reason.
users.activateText: They will be able to log in again, and a company's offers will be visible again. They are notified by email.
users.reasonHint: It is sent to the user.

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Every offer in the portal, in any status. Removing one hides it from students; its company sees the reason.
offers.removeText: Students will no longer see it or be able to apply, and its conversations are closed. The company is notified with the reason.
offers.restoreText: It goes back to the status it had before being removed, and the company is notified.
offers.moderationHint: As an administrator you can remove this offer from the portal or restore it.
